title: What Your Team Sees After AI Handles a Call
summary: What a hotel team receives after AI answers a call: a written summary of every call, a structured handover when a person is needed, a daily report of the questions it could not answer, and corrections made by replying to an email.
body_markdown:
Common questions


## FAQ


### What does a hotel team receive after an AI answers a call?


A written record of the call. That includes a transcript of what was said, a machine-generated summary of the request and its outcome, and metadata such as the date, time, and duration. No call audio is stored; what is kept is text only, the transcript and the summary.


If the call needed a person and none was available, the team also receives a structured handover with the essential information collected, so a specific next action is waiting rather than a message in a box nobody opens. Over time the team also receives a report of the questions the AI could not answer, as a list of gaps to close.


### What is a hotel knowledge-gap report?


It is a section of the daily performance report that lists the exact guest questions the AI could not answer, or answered only partially, phrased in the guest's own words, so a general manager or responsible team member has a concrete to-do list of what the property could not answer that day.


Most hotels have no way to see these questions at all, because a person who does not know an answer leaves no record of the question. Turning those unanswered questions into a dated, specific list is what makes a gap fixable rather than invisible.


### How do you correct a wrong answer an AI gave a guest?


By replying to the automated call-summary email. The reply opens a support ticket automatically, and the correction flows into the property's knowledge base, so a wrong or out-of-date answer is fixed inside the team's normal inbox rather than through a separate tool or a formal request.


Knowledge and workflow changes are tested against anonymized real calls before they go live, so a fix for one answer does not break others. In one case a property's incorrect parking information was corrected three days after the reply.


### What happens to a call the AI cannot finish on the line?


It is captured, not dropped. A complaint is acknowledged, the essential information is collected, and a structured handover is created for follow-up. A booking the property management system could not confirm in the moment is handed over as a captured request with the details attached and the confirmation marked pending.


A request for a member of staff who cannot be reached becomes a message routed to the right desk, and outside staffed hours a call still produces a logged note. Completed bookings sit in the property management system, which remains the system of record. A call never lands as nothing.


### Does an AI phone system record calls?


No call audio is stored. Text transcripts and machine-generated summaries may be retained so requests can be completed, reviewed, and followed up, with a published retention period of 24 months for those transcripts and summaries. The summary, not a recording, is what the hotel team reads after the call.
